tom-finance: MeterWise renewal quote landed. They billed 14,200 CUs in our pilot month but the invoice line only shows $1,050. Our model telemetry suggests ~3.55M tokens => ~$3,550 at our benchmark. Who can confirm their CU definition?

anya-eng: I pulled their trial usage export. They define CU as 1 CU = 500 model-steps in their default profile, but they also apply a model multiplier for larger architectures (x1.5 for large models). Sample rows from export:```date,compute_units,model,multiplier
2026-04-03,5600,redwood-open-13,1
2026-04-10,3800,redwood-open-70,1.5
2026-04-18,4800,redwood-open-13,1```
cole-ops: We need a normalized tokens-per-CU to compare apples-to-apples. Please ask MeterWise for a CSV mapping CU->approx tokens by model and sequence-length bucket. Also request the raw billing export showing discounts and promo flags.
marie-sales: I asked the rep for their SKU breakdown and tiered pricing table. They acknowledged the pilot invoice included a 70% promotional credit. They say the renewal quote is on list pricing. We need net30 and a 6-month introductory commit discount to bridge the gap.
diana-legal: Red flag: their renewal language includes a 30-day auto-renew with invoice payable immediately. We should require net30, written notice 60 days before renewal, and a max annual increase of 5% or CPI+1% whichever is lower. Also add an audit right for billing exports quarterly.
meterwise-rep: meterwise-rep: Apologies for the initial confusion. We ran a limited pilot discount; sample invoice didn't surface credits clearly. Our standard CU is 1 CU = 500 model-steps, but effective tokens/CU varies by model and generation length. We'll upload a normalized CSV (tokens_estimate_per_CU_by_model.csv) and a reconciled billing export showing promo credits. For renewals we can offer net30 on enterprise PO and a 10% discount for a 6-month commit. Auto-renew can be turned off for the PO.
billing-bot: billing-bot: meterwise_promo_invoice_april2026.pdf uploaded (https://files.slack/meterwise/meterwise_promo_invoice_april2026.pdf)
anya-eng: Quick calc using their baseline (1 CU = 500 tokens) -> 14,200 CUs ~7.1M tokens. That would be ~$7,100 at $1/1k tokens, so invoice at $1,050 lines up only if there was a >85% promo credit. We need their billing export to verify applied discounts and any trial caps.
cole-ops: Filed a request to MeterWise billing team for the raw CSV and invoice breakdown. ETA 48 hours. I'll reconcile once received.
marie-sales: I'll push for a 15% first-year commit and confirmation net30/no-auto-renew on the PO. If they won't go below 10% we can consider a smaller purchase order to keep pilot production running.
diana-legal: Add clause: explicit list of billable SKUs and mapping to CU on the SOW. Also require 30-day dispute window post-invoice for billing disagreements.
meterwise-rep: meterwise-rep: Uploaded normalized CSV and sample_invoice_line.csv to secure link; granting access to your billing contact. Confirmed net30 and disabled auto-renew option for the pilot PO. Can do 10-15% commit discount depending on annualized volume.
tom-finance: Thanks. Action items: @cole-ops get and reconcile raw billing export; @meterwise-rep confirm sample invoice row and CSV (they said done); @marie-sales finalize commit negotiation (aim 15%). Reopen when reconciliation is complete.
